body:
Moved the editor's Upload button from the right sidebar to the top-left hover-reveal bar, next to Save (founder: button was hard to find). Built examples/host_led/led_main.c, reusing examples/avr/blink.prn's exact next_led_state decision logic to drive this sandbox's own real /sys/class/leds *::scrolllock keyboard LED (no physical Arduino/USB device exists here). New Makefile host-led-blink-build target (no root) + sudo-queue/77-blink-onboard-led.sh (the one root-needing step, bounded to 10 on/off cycles). Live-verified as non-root: finds the real LED path, fails only at the expected EACCES permission boundary. editor-demo builds clean (-Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror), make test: 347/347.

⚓ ☃
title: AVR/Arduino followup: Upload button moved to top bar + real host-LED blink proof
